description: This file declares the API prototypes for the task watchdog module in Zephyr OS, including initialization, adding, deleting, and feeding watchdog channels.

methods.name: task_wdt_init
methods.description: Initializes the task watchdog, setting up kernel timers and optional hardware watchdog fallback.

methods.name: task_wdt_add
methods.description: Adds a new timeout to monitor a task, returning a channel ID.

methods.name: task_wdt_delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified watchdog channel, freeing it for reuse.

methods.name: task_wdt_feed
methods.description: Feeds a specific watchdog channel to reset its timer.
